properties.description: The conduct rule is pinned where an edit that drops it turns red: both capture-intent and genesis must forbid asking the user which node type to use AND name describe_schema as the alternative (forbidding a question without naming the alternative is half a rule), and capture-intent must carry the routing table as a lookup table that names where it runs out. 2 cases in crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/served_skills.rs, 8 in the file, all passing. THE POINT OF PINNING IT HERE: this is a rule about how an agent behaves in conversation, and conversation leaves no node — loop_status reads perfectly clean through a session that breaks it, so a test on the served text is the only place it can be observed at all.
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED: replacing "Never ask the user which node type" with its opposite across all three skill trees turned exactly the conduct test red and left the routing-table test green; reverting restored both.
properties.name: The capture skills never ask the user which node type to use
